B3_stopPhysicalGap.label: stop_work ends the work but nothing reaches the physical writer

B3_stopPhysicalGap.harnessCorrectionRecorded: the first run showed the same empty result for a different reason: the producer completed the turn immediately after the approval, so there was no live turn to stop.
